title: Artifact for ParaProofa: A Certifying Parallel Cube-and-Conquer QBF-Solving Framework
scope: The data source covers the 70 selected input instances listed below. Programs bundled in the supplement retain their own licenses.
license_interpretation: The record publishes test data under CC-BY-4.0, and its README identifies gallery22 and gallery23. The archive-root MIT text applies to software and documentation; bundled programs retain their individual licenses. The selected data uses the dataset record as its distribution basis and preserves the Toronto research conditions for the three BMC instances.
attribution: Peyrer, Mark; Heisinger, Maximilian; Seidl, Martina (2026). Artifact for ParaProofa: A Certifying Parallel Cube-and-Conquer QBF-Solving Framework, v1. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.18832723. Original QBF contributors and family URLs are retained in qbf-original-source-review.json.

operations: Variable bijection within each quantifier block
Removal of original comment headers; preserve them through companion attribution material
transform.verification: Official-member SHA-256 values match the fixed transformation input hashes; image plaintext SHA-256 values match the fixed transformation output hashes.
transform.seeds_and_variable_maps: This source record identifies fixed transformation inputs and outputs by SHA-256. Seeds and variable maps are not included in this record.

gttt_alias.match_basis: Full member content hash; matched against the frozen transformation input hash, not only its filename.

development_provenance_limit: The fixed archive supplies the source content identified by the recorded input hashes.
integration: Include the dataset license and original family/author notices, including the Toronto terms, with source and judge distributions.
